visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a brightly lit indoor vanity setting, a pair of feminine hands with light beige manicured nails is centered in the frame. The hands rest on a polished white marble surface. One hand picks up a dark amber glass bottle with a black spray nozzle. The bottle's label clearly reads "SCALP ESSENCE RED QUINOA" under the "WSTYLE" brand logo. The background features a large mirror reflecting the hands and several other beauty bottles, creating a clean, high-end atmosphere. (2) The scene shifts as the hand places the amber bottle down and moves toward a taller, clear cylindrical bottle containing a pale yellow oil. This bottle is labeled "Wstyle" and "ROSE & LAVENDER Smoothing Hair Oil" with a silver pump top. The white marble vanity reflects the soft, even studio-style lighting, and the mirror in the background shows a slightly different angle of the product arrangement. (3) The hand touches the clear hair oil bottle, focusing the viewer's attention on its texture and branding. The framing remains a medium close-up, emphasizing the products' physical details and the elegance of the setting. The marble surface is pristine, and the reflection in the mirror remains sharp. (4) Finally, the hand moves to a white opaque bottle with a black cap, identified by the label as "WSTYLE DRY SHAMPOO". The hand lightly taps the top of the black cap. The surrounding bottles from the previous phases are visible in a neat row, and the bright, natural-looking artificial lighting remains constant across the marble and mirrored surfaces.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy K-pop music track characterized by a fast-paced electronic beat and powerful female vocals singing in a mix of Korean and English. The production is highly polished with a bright spectral balance. A sharp, rhythmic "pop" or digital "click" sound effect is heard as the first product is highlighted. There are no environmental sounds or spoken words. (2) As the track progresses, the driving rhythmic bass and synth chords continue steadily at approximately 122 BPM. The female singer's voice is processed and energetic. A second crisp digital sound effect triggers, perfectly synchronized with a visual transition or text update, adding a percussive layer to the mix. The overall sound is clean and studio-quality. (3) The pop track maintains its high arousal and positive valence, focusing on a catchy melodic hook. No incidental noises like rustling or thudding are audible, indicating a post-produced master track. A third digital SFX occurs, maintaining the rhythmic structure and editing pace. The spectral centroid remains high, providing a sharp and modern acoustic feel. (4) The music continues through its rhythmic cycle with no changes in tempo or mode. The vocal energy remains consistent. A final digital sound effect is heard, coinciding with the last product interaction. The audio concludes with the music track still in progress, ending precisely with the video's cut. The entire soundscape is dominated by the commercial BGM and intentional editing SFX.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a specific set of hair care travel essentials from the brand Wstyle. By using a clean, aesthetic visual presentation on a marble vanity and high-energy, trendy K-pop music, it appeals to a fashion-conscious audience looking for convenient beauty solutions while traveling.
